cause: The runner declared the mandatory auxiliary record fields with Portuguese labels such as Escopo verificado, Estado testado, Comandos executados, and Testes selecionados, while the execution-record parser accepts the canonical English field names Tested scope, Tested state, Commands, and Selected checks.
rootCauseAssessment: The runner contracts and contract checker advertised translated field labels that contradicted the canonical English execution-record schema and runtime parser. The caller correctly failed closed; no runtime relaxation or label alias was justified.
